description: Haltestelle: Übersicht Bahnhofpläne Trafimage is a dataset listed in SBB open data platform, an open data platform of a railway operator, published or maintained by SBB (Swiss Federal Railways). Bahnhofpläne liefern Informationen zum Ein-, Aus- und Umsteigen, zeigen die Serviceleistungen, das kommerzielle Angebot und die kombinierte Mobilität im und um den Bahnhof. Es gibt sie mittlerweile für mehr als 60 Stationen. Um alle Bahnhöfe zu sehen, die mit einem Plan ausgerüstet sind, bitte in die Karte hineinzoomen. Coverage: Switzerland. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Mobility and Transport. Its keywords are Verkehr, Bahnhof. The portal shows 2026-07-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is https://data.sbb.ch/page/licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sbb-open-data-portal.
